description:
Update an existing element by `type` and `id`, changing ONLY the fields you
pass; omitted fields are kept.

This is the same partial update as `PATCH /api/v2/{type}/{id}`: each field you
pass replaces that field's value whole. A text field you pass is set (pass an
empty string `""` to clear it). A multi-link field you pass REPLACES that
field's whole array with the array you send (pass an empty array `[]` to clear
it): a partial array drops every link it leaves out (only links your key
cannot see are kept). To keep the rest, read the element first and send the
whole array, or use `edit_links`, which adds or removes single links and
leaves the rest of the array as it is. `type` is a slug from
`list_element_types`; `id` is the element's UUID. Requires a WRITE API-Key.
Returns the full updated element in the v2 wire shape. Errors if the element
does not exist, or (naming the field) on an unknown field or a bad link target.
On a world that takes an agent seat's writes as proposals, a seat's update is
proposed, not applied: the answer is `{proposed, proposal}`, never the
element, and a keeper (the owner or a co-builder) accepts or declines it.
`if_match` (optional) is the element's `change_seq` as you read it: the
`change_seq` field every v2 answer carries on the element, as
`PATCH /api/v2/{type}/{id}` takes it in its `If-Match` header. The update
applies only while the element is still at that number; if anyone wrote it
since, nothing is written and the error's code is `precondition_failed`, with
the element as it is now under `current`: re-read it, then send again or ask
the user. Left out, the update applies whatever changed in between.
A refusal from keel is the API's own error as JSON text, `{"error":
{message, type, code, param, doc_url}}` (as the HTTP route answers it), with
`retry_after` (seconds) beside it when the route would send Retry-After.
name: update_element
